software.metaDescription: DentiCareApp brings patient records, dental charting, appointments, prescriptions and invoicing together in one online software for dental practices. 3-month free trial.
software.teaser: Your whole practice in one online tool.
software.h1: Practice management software built for dental practices
software.intro: DentiCareApp brings together everything that keeps your practice running: patients, treatment records, dental chart, appointments, prescriptions and invoices. It all runs online, from a computer, tablet or phone, with nothing to install.

blocks.title: Patients and treatment records
blocks.text: Every patient has a complete profile: contact details, date of birth, insurance and visit history. Care for the same treatment is grouped in one record, with its procedures, payments and balance due.

blocks.title: Interactive dental chart
blocks.text: An anatomical odontogram, adult or child depending on the patient's age, that you annotate tooth by tooth. It updates itself when you bill a procedure on a tooth.

blocks.title: Calendar and appointments
blocks.text: Schedule appointments as a list or in calendar view, send a WhatsApp reminder in one click and turn a completed appointment into a visit.

blocks.title: Invoices, quotes and prescriptions
blocks.text: Quotes, invoices, deposits and prescriptions printed as PDFs in your practice's name. CNOPS and CNSS claim forms are pre-filled from the patient record.

benefits: Less paperwork, more time for your patients
All of a patient's information in one place
The right access for each team member: manager, dentist or assistant
An interface available in French, English and Arabic

appointments.metaDescription: Manage your dental practice's calendar with DentiCareApp: appointments as a list or calendar, one-click WhatsApp reminders and a direct link between each appointment and its visit.
appointments.teaser: A clear calendar and one-click reminders.
appointments.h1: Your dental practice's calendar, simple and always up to date
appointments.intro: With DentiCareApp, you schedule and track the whole practice's appointments in one place. Each appointment is linked to the patient and, once completed, to the visit it led to.

blocks.title: List or calendar
blocks.text: Switch in one click from the appointment list to the calendar view to see the practice's day or week.

blocks.title: One-click WhatsApp reminder
blocks.text: Send the patient a ready-written WhatsApp reminder, straight from the appointment page.

blocks.title: From appointment to visit
blocks.text: When an appointment is completed, link it to an existing visit or create one right away, with the procedures performed and their billing.

blocks.title: Built for the assistant
blocks.text: The assistant creates patients, opens records and manages appointments, without access to clinical data or billing.

benefits: Fewer forgotten and missed appointments
A clear view of the practice's workload
No double entry between the calendar and the patient record
A precise status for every appointment: scheduled, completed, no-show or cancelled

chart.metaDescription: The DentiCareApp dental chart: anatomical adult and child odontogram, status of every tooth, automatic updates from billed procedures and a printable patient sheet.
chart.teaser: Each patient's odontogram, always up to date.
chart.h1: An interactive dental chart for every patient
chart.intro: DentiCareApp shows each patient's mouth as an anatomical odontogram. You see caries, fillings, crowns, implants or missing teeth at a glance, and update it in a few clicks.

blocks.title: Adult or child, automatically
blocks.text: The chart adapts to the patient's age: permanent teeth for adults, primary teeth for children, with FDI numbering.

blocks.title: The status of every tooth
blocks.text: Mark each tooth as decayed, filled, crowned, to treat, prosthesis, bridge, implant or missing, and add a note if needed.

blocks.title: Linked to billing
blocks.text: When you bill a procedure on a tooth, you pick it directly on the chart and its status updates automatically.

blocks.title: Printable and shareable
blocks.text: Print the patient sheet with its dental chart. Patients can also view it in their personal space.

benefits: A complete view of the patient's mouth at every visit
Fewer tooth mix-ups between treatment and invoice
Clearer explanations for the patient
A chart that is always up to date, with no double entry

claims.metaTitle: Pre-filled CNOPS and CNSS dental claim forms
claims.metaDescription: DentiCareApp fills in CNOPS and CNSS dental claim forms for you, on the official forms, from the patient's profile and treatment record.
claims.teaser: The official forms, filled in for you.
claims.h1: Your CNOPS and CNSS claim forms, pre-filled in one click
claims.intro: No more copying patient details by hand. From the treatment record, DentiCareApp generates the CNOPS or CNSS claim form on the official form, ready to print.

blocks.title: On the official form
blocks.text: The details are placed directly on the official CNOPS or CNSS template, not on a rough imitation.

blocks.title: Patient details filled in automatically
blocks.text: Name, ID number, date of birth, insurer and membership number are taken from the patient's profile.

blocks.title: One INPE per practitioner
blocks.text: Each dentist in the practice is registered with their own INPE, so documents carry the right practitioner's name.

blocks.title: One form per treatment record
blocks.text: The claim form is generated from the treatment record, where the patient's care is grouped.

benefits: Less time spent filling in forms
Fewer copying mistakes
Patients better supported in their reimbursement claims
Clean, legible forms

billing.metaTitle: Invoicing, quotes and prescriptions for dental practices
billing.metaDescription: With DentiCareApp, create quotes, invoices and prescriptions as PDFs, track deposits and the balance due on each record, and give patients secure access to their documents.
billing.teaser: Quotes, invoices, deposits and prescriptions, effortlessly.
billing.h1: Clear invoicing for your dental practice
billing.intro: DentiCareApp links invoicing to care: procedures performed during a visit are added to the record's invoice, deposits are tracked and the balance due is always up to date.

blocks.title: Quotes and invoices as PDFs
blocks.text: Prepare quotes and invoices, and print professional documents with your practice's name and logo.

blocks.title: Deposits and balance due
blocks.text: Record each patient payment and track the balance due on every treatment record.

blocks.title: Prescriptions
blocks.text: Write prescriptions from your medication catalogue, with default dosages, and print them in one click.

blocks.title: Patient space with QR code
blocks.text: Every document carries a QR code that opens the patient's personal space, protected by their date of birth, where they find their invoices and prescriptions.

benefits: Accurate invoices, linked to the procedures actually performed
An invoice is never deleted: it is cancelled and stays traceable
The practice's revenue at a glance
Fewer patient questions about payments

faq.metaDescription: All the answers about DentiCareApp, the dental practice management software: free trial, installation, data security, team, languages and claim forms.
faq.teaser: Answers to your questions about DentiCareApp.
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before getting started with DentiCareApp.

items.a: DentiCareApp is online management software for dental practices. It brings together patient profiles, treatment records, the dental chart, appointments, prescriptions and invoicing.
You start with a 3-month free trial. After that, a single monthly subscription with no commitment gives access to every feature. Contact us to find out the price for your practice.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. DentiCareApp runs in the browser, on a computer, tablet or phone. All you need is an internet connection.
Yes. Connections are encrypted, access is protected by a personal password and each practice's data is kept strictly separate from other practices.

items.q: Can I work with my team?
items.a: Yes. Invite your dentists and assistants. Each member has a role: assistants manage patients, records and appointments, without access to clinical data or billing.

items.q: Which languages is DentiCareApp available in?
items.a: The interface is available in French, English and Arabic. Each team member chooses their own language.

items.q: Can my patients access their documents?
items.a: Yes. Invoices and prescriptions carry a QR code that opens the patient's personal space, protected by their date of birth, where they find their documents and dental chart.
Create your account in a few minutes, with no credit card. Your 3-month free trial starts as soon as your account is open.
